literature.headline_zh: 狂犬病防控取得新进展:新型单抗疗法与数字提醒系统并行。
literature.lead_zh: 近期研究显示,新型人源化单克隆抗体和数字提醒系统在狂犬病防控中展现出重要潜力,同时各国在疫苗依从性和社区参与方面仍面临挑战。
key_findings_zh: 人源化单克隆抗体A6和SYN023分别通过稳定G蛋白融合前状态和广谱中和活性,在动物模型中显著提高存活率并促进长期功能恢复 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2736987]。
数字提醒系统(短信或电话)可将狂犬病疫苗完成率从53%提升至70%-93%,但证据异质性高需大规模随机试验验证 [10.25259/ijmr_399_2026]。
伊朗全国登记分析显示,尽管96%患者在48小时内完成首针疫苗接种,但暴露分类错误和免疫球蛋白误用仍普遍存在 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014751]。
越南Nghe An省卫生专业人员中,仅63.9%具备良好防控实践,培训可将良好实践率提高3倍以上 [10.5365/wpsar.2026.17.3.1433]。
乌干达和印度等地社区对狂犬病有较高认知度,但传统伤口处理和经济障碍仍阻碍及时治疗 [10.1136/bmjph-2025-004805]。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 狂犬病暴露后预防(PEP)的及时性和依从性仍是全球防控的关键瓶颈,尤其在资源有限地区,老年人和农村人群面临更大风险。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分研究为横断面或回顾性设计,存在自我报告偏差;数字提醒系统的有效性证据异质性高,需更多随机对照试验验证;单抗疗法多为动物实验,临床数据有限。
literature.headline_en: Rabies control advances with novel monoclonal antibodies and digital reminders.
literature.lead_en: Recent studies show promising potential of novel humanized monoclonal antibodies and digital reminder systems in rabies prevention, while countries still face challenges in vaccine compliance and community engagement.
key_findings_en: Humanized monoclonal antibodies A6 and SYN023 demonstrated significant protection in animal models by stabilizing the prefusion G protein state and exhibiting broad neutralization, improving survival and long-term functional recovery [10.1080/22221751.2026.2736987]
Digital reminder systems (SMS or phone calls) increased rabies vaccine completion rates from 53% to 70-93%, though evidence heterogeneity requires larger randomized trials [10.25259/ijmr_399_2026]

Iran's nationwide registry analysis revealed 96% of patients received first vaccine dose within 48 hours, but exposure misclassification and inappropriate immunoglobulin use remain prevalent [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014751]
In Vietnam's Nghe An province, only 63.9% of surveillance professionals had adequate practices, with recent training tripling the likelihood of proper compliance [10.5365/wpsar.2026.17.3.1433]
Community awareness of rabies is high in Uganda and India, but traditional wound care and economic barriers still hinder timely treatment [10.1136/bmjph-2025-004805]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: Timeliness and compliance of post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) remain critical bottlenecks in global rabies control, with older adults and rural populations facing greater risks.
literature.caveats_en: Some studies used cross-sectional or retrospective designs with potential self-report bias; digital reminder effectiveness evidence is heterogeneous and needs more RCTs; monoclonal antibody therapies are mostly animal studies with limited clinical data.
literature.brief_en: Recent research highlights advances in rabies prevention through novel monoclonal antibodies and digital reminder systems, while revealing persistent gaps in vaccine compliance, exposure classification, and community-level barriers to timely treatment across diverse global settings.

news.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 农业部将于 10 月在沃克县投放口服 狂犬病 狂犬病 (ORV) 诱饵,以防止野生动物感染 狂犬病,以保护人和宠物。这是佐治亚州沃克县 (.gov) 网站报道的已确认事件。 [news-1ed54face9543c85]
通过持续投资、强有力的政府领导、人类和动物卫生部门的协调行动以及与世界卫生组织 (WHO) 的合作,斯里兰卡正在努力争取到 2030 年实现人类零死亡。报告证实了这一点,报告强调了该国的进展和正在进行的努力。 [news-95a87ca28fd88b36]
狂犬病 正在长岛的浣熊中传播,卫生官员正在分发口服 狂犬病 疫苗 诱饵来控制 狂犬病。萨福克县卫生服务部和拿骚县卫生局已实施这些措施。 [news-203fed855f4e8c30]
CDC 注意到,全国范围内 狂犬病 接触报告有所增加,与 2025 年同期相比,询问量增加了 17%。专家建议在接触蝙蝠或动物咬伤后寻求医疗救助。 [news-13bb274630a0ef60]
一项来自中国杭州的回顾性研究发表在《BMC传染病》上,发现与年轻人相比,65岁及以上的老年人在被动物咬伤后更有可能推迟寻求狂犬病 治疗。这种延迟是通过在随后的日历日而不是受伤当天就诊来衡量的。该研究还检查了院前伤口处理,发现自我 治疗 在老年人中较少见,尽管没有统计学意义。 [news-30b7b18646d6c330]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Rabies virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Department of Agriculture will be dropping oral rabies vaccination (ORV) baits across Walker County in October, in an effort to protect people and pets — by preventing rabies in wildlife. This is a confirmed event reported by the Walker County, GA (.gov) website. [news-1ed54face9543c85]

Sri Lanka is advancing towards achieving zero human rabies deaths by 2030 through sustained investment, strong government leadership, coordinated action across human and animal health sectors, and collaboration with the World Health Organization (WHO). [news-95a87ca28fd88b36]

Rabies is spreading among raccoons in Long Island, and health officials are distributing oral rabies vaccine baits to control the outbreak. The Suffolk County Department of Health Services and Nassau County Department of Health have implemented these measures. [news-203fed855f4e8c30]

A nationwide increase in rabies exposure reports was noted by the CDC, with 17% more inquiries compared to the same period in 2025. Experts advise seeking medical attention following exposure to bats or animal bites. [news-13bb274630a0ef60]

A retrospective study from Hangzhou, China, published in BMC Infectious Diseases, found that older adults aged 65 and older are significantly more likely to delay seeking rabies treatment after animal bites compared to younger adults. [news-30b7b18646d6c330]

papers.title: Compliance with Two Vaccination Regimens of Freeze-Dried Human Rabies Vaccine (Vero Cell) and Influencing Factors in Hubei Province, China
papers.abstract: Objective: To systematically analyze the practical application and differences in vaccination compliance of two rabies post-exposure prophylaxis regimens based on real-world data, and to explore the associated influencing factors of vaccination compliance, aiming to provide evidence for optimizing vaccination strategies. Methods: Vaccination records of exposed individuals who received the freeze-dried human rabies vaccine (Vero cell) documented in the Hubei Provincial Immunization Information Management System from 1 January to 31 December 2024 were retrospectively collected to evaluate compliance with the five-dose (Essen) and four-dose (Zagreb) vaccination schedules. Good compliance was defined as completing the vaccination according to the schedule within the prescribed time frame. The evaluation included the vaccination compliance rate and the full-course vaccination rate. Factors associated with compliance were explored using univariate and multivariable analyses. Results: A total of 51,066 subjects were enrolled. The four-dose (Zagreb) schedule was associated with significantly higher vaccination compliance (77.1% vs. 72.0%, χ2 = 94.913, p < 0.05) and full-course completion rates (85.2% vs. 82.4%, χ2 = 38.251, p < 0.05), whereas the five-dose (Essen) regimen was associated with a higher rate of timely initial vaccination (81.7% vs. 78.1%, χ2 = 61.602, p < 0.05). In the multivariable analysis, the four-dose (Zagreb) regimen was also associated with increased full-course completion (aOR = 1.49, 95% CI = 1.39–1.60) and better compliance (aOR = 1.52, 95% CI = 1.43–1.61), whereas in a pre-specified, descriptive exploratory model, it was associated with delayed first doses (exploratory aOR = 0.84, 95% CI = 0.79–0.89); this adjusted association should not be interpreted as a causal effect of regimen on timely initiation. Younger age, lower-limb wounds, high-security occupations, farming, passive immunization and non-winter exposure were associated with better full-course vaccination; adults aged ≥18 years, males, Han/Miao ethnicity, Grade III exposure and cat bites were associated with lower compliance (p < 0.05). Severe exposure, farmer/student/resident identity, passive immunization and spring exposure were associated with more timely initiation, whereas male sex, neck-and-above exposure and flexible work were associated with less timely initiation (p < 0.05). Conclusions: In this retrospective, non-randomized study, receipt of the four-dose (Zagreb) regimen was associated with modestly higher full-course completion (absolute difference: 2.8 percentage points) and better compliance (5.1 percentage points) than the five-dose (Essen) regimen. Conversely, it was associated with a lower rate of timely first-dose vaccination. As an observational study, these findings do not establish causal relationships. Therefore, immediate wound care, prompt vaccination, and appropriate administration of rabies immunoglobulin remain the principal clinical priorities.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在基于真实数据,系统分析两种狂犬病 暴露后预防方案的实际应用情况及疫苗接种依从性差异,并探讨疫苗接种依从性的相关影响因素,旨在为优化疫苗接种策略提供依据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾性收集了湖北省免疫信息管理系统中2024年1月1日至12月31日期间接受冻干人狂犬病 疫苗(Vero细胞)的暴露者的疫苗接种记录,共纳入51,066名受试者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用单变量和多变量分析探讨与依从性相关的因素。良好的合规性定义为在规定的时间范围内按照时间表完成疫苗接种。
elements_zh.main_results: 四剂(萨格勒布)方案与显着较高的 疫苗接种 依从性(77.1% vs. 72.0%,χ2 = 94.913,p < 0.05)和全程完成率(85.2% vs. 82.4%,χ2 = 38.251,p < 0.05)相关,而五剂(埃森)方案则与显着较高的 疫苗接种 依从性相关。及时初始 疫苗接种 的比率较高(81.7% vs. 78.1%,χ2 = 61.602,p < 0.05)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与五剂(埃森)方案相比,四剂(萨格勒布)方案与较高的全程完成率(绝对差异:2.8 个百分点)和更好的依从性(5.1 个百分点)相关。然而,这也与及时首次接种 疫苗接种 的比率较低有关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,四剂量方案可能更有效地确保全程 疫苗接种 完成,这可以为在现实环境中改善 狂犬病 暴露后预防 的策略提供参考。立即伤口护理、及时 疫苗接种 和适当施用 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白仍然是主要的临床重点。

papers.title_zh: 中国湖北省冻干人 狂犬病 疫苗(Vero 细胞)两种 疫苗接种 治疗方案的符合性及影响因素
papers.source_body_en: Objective: To systematically analyze the practical application and differences in vaccination compliance of two rabies post-exposure prophylaxis regimens based on real-world data, and to explore the associated influencing factors of vaccination compliance, aiming to provide evidence for optimizing vaccination strategies. Methods: Vaccination records of exposed individuals who received the freeze-dried human rabies vaccine (Vero cell) documented in the Hubei Provincial Immunization Information Management System from 1 January to 31 December 2024 were retrospectively collected to evaluate compliance with the five-dose (Essen) and four-dose (Zagreb) vaccination schedules. Good compliance was defined as completing the vaccination according to the schedule within the prescribed time frame. The evaluation included the vaccination compliance rate and the full-course vaccination rate. Factors associated with compliance were explored using univariate and multivariable analyses. Results: A total of 51,066 subjects were enrolled. The four-dose (Zagreb) schedule was associated with significantly higher vaccination compliance (77.1% vs. 72.0%, χ2 = 94.913, p < 0.05) and full-course completion rates (85.2% vs. 82.4%, χ2 = 38.251, p < 0.05), whereas the five-dose (Essen) regimen was associated with a higher rate of timely initial vaccination (81.7% vs. 78.1%, χ2 = 61.602, p < 0.05). In the multivariable analysis, the four-dose (Zagreb) regimen was also associated with increased full-course completion (aOR = 1.49, 95% CI = 1.39–1.60) and better compliance (aOR = 1.52, 95% CI = 1.43–1.61), whereas in a pre-specified, descriptive exploratory model, it was associated with delayed first doses (exploratory aOR = 0.84, 95% CI = 0.79–0.89); this adjusted association should not be interpreted as a causal effect of regimen on timely initiation. Younger age, lower-limb wounds, high-security occupations, farming, passive immunization and non-winter exposure were associated with better full-course vaccination; adults aged ≥18 years, males, Han/Miao ethnicity, Grade III exposure and cat bites were associated with lower compliance (p < 0.05). Severe exposure, farmer/student/resident identity, passive immunization and spring exposure were associated with more timely initiation, whereas male sex, neck-and-above exposure and flexible work were associated with less timely initiation (p < 0.05). Conclusions: In this retrospective, non-randomized study, receipt of the four-dose (Zagreb) regimen was associated with modestly higher full-course completion (absolute difference: 2.8 percentage points) and better compliance (5.1 percentage points) than the five-dose (Essen) regimen. Conversely, it was associated with a lower rate of timely first-dose vaccination. As an observational study, these findings do not establish causal relationships. Therefore, immediate wound care, prompt vaccination, and appropriate administration of rabies immunoglobulin remain the principal clinical priorities.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在基于真实数据,系统分析两种狂犬病 暴露后预防方案的实际应用情况及疫苗接种依从性差异,并探讨疫苗接种依从性的相关影响因素,旨在为优化疫苗接种策略提供依据。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾性收集了湖北省免疫信息管理系统中2024年1月1日至12月31日期间接受冻干人狂犬病 疫苗(Vero细胞)的暴露者的疫苗接种记录,共纳入51,066名受试者。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用单变量和多变量分析探讨与依从性相关的因素。良好的合规性定义为在规定的时间范围内按照时间表完成疫苗接种。
analysis_zh.main_results: 四剂(萨格勒布)方案与显着较高的 疫苗接种 依从性(77.1% vs. 72.0%,χ2 = 94.913,p < 0.05)和全程完成率(85.2% vs. 82.4%,χ2 = 38.251,p < 0.05)相关,而五剂(埃森)方案则与显着较高的 疫苗接种 依从性相关。及时初始 疫苗接种 的比率较高(81.7% vs. 78.1%,χ2 = 61.602,p < 0.05)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与五剂(埃森)方案相比,四剂(萨格勒布)方案与较高的全程完成率(绝对差异:2.8 个百分点)和更好的依从性(5.1 个百分点)相关。然而,这也与及时首次接种 疫苗接种 的比率较低有关。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,四剂量方案可能更有效地确保全程 疫苗接种 完成,这可以为在现实环境中改善 狂犬病 暴露后预防 的策略提供参考。立即伤口护理、及时 疫苗接种 和适当施用 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白仍然是主要的临床重点。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项观察性研究,这些发现并未建立因果关系。该研究是回顾性且非随机的,这可能会引入偏差并限制证据的强度。

papers.title: Peripheral human mAb therapy yields modulation of neuroinflammation and long-term functional recovery from lyssavirus infection
papers.abstract: Rabies is a fatal encephalitis caused by viruses in the lyssavirus genus. We previously demonstrated that intraperitoneal administration of a single dose of neutralizing human monoclonal antibody (mAb) F11 can protect mice from fatal lyssavirus infection, post-central nervous system (CNS) invasion. However, the molecular basis of F11 neutralization remains unknown. Here, we use structural and functional analyses to define neutralizing activity of F11 and the related mAb, A6. Cryo-electron microscopy (EM) and negative-stain EM reveal that both mAbs bind Domain III of the glycoprotein G, recognizing a prefusion-specific epitope distinct from previously characterized antibodies including RVC20. Binding stabilizes the prefusion state, blocking membrane fusion. We furthermore found that a single dose of either A6 or RVC20 protected animals from mortality induced by Australian bat lyssavirus (ABLV), while promoting substantial long-term functional recovery. Moreover, A6 similarly protected animals from mortality following infection with a currently circulating wild isolate of rabies virus (RABV). Transcriptomics analysis of brain RNA and protein-based analysis of brain tissue homogenates demonstrated that therapy with A6 broadly reduced expression of neuroinflammatory mediators during the acute phase of infection. Interestingly, infection of animals with a non-lethal attenuated mutant of ABLV resulted in similar neuroinflammation. Thus, a robust neuroinflammatory response to ABLV does not predict mortality. Overall, peripheral therapy with A6 and similar neutralizing mAbs promotes survival and long-term functional recovery from CNS-resident lyssavirus infection in a manner that includes suppression of the G pre- to postfusion transition and modulation of neuroinflammation.

papers.title_zh: 外周人类单克隆抗体疗法可调节神经炎症并实现狂犬病病毒感染的长期功能恢复
papers.source_body_en: Rabies is a fatal encephalitis caused by viruses in the lyssavirus genus. We previously demonstrated that intraperitoneal administration of a single dose of neutralizing human monoclonal antibody (mAb) F11 can protect mice from fatal lyssavirus infection, post-central nervous system (CNS) invasion. However, the molecular basis of F11 neutralization remains unknown. Here, we use structural and functional analyses to define neutralizing activity of F11 and the related mAb, A6. Cryo-electron microscopy (EM) and negative-stain EM reveal that both mAbs bind Domain III of the glycoprotein G, recognizing a prefusion-specific epitope distinct from previously characterized antibodies including RVC20. Binding stabilizes the prefusion state, blocking membrane fusion. We furthermore found that a single dose of either A6 or RVC20 protected animals from mortality induced by Australian bat lyssavirus (ABLV), while promoting substantial long-term functional recovery. Moreover, A6 similarly protected animals from mortality following infection with a currently circulating wild isolate of rabies virus (RABV). Transcriptomics analysis of brain RNA and protein-based analysis of brain tissue homogenates demonstrated that therapy with A6 broadly reduced expression of neuroinflammatory mediators during the acute phase of infection. Interestingly, infection of animals with a non-lethal attenuated mutant of ABLV resulted in similar neuroinflammation. Thus, a robust neuroinflammatory response to ABLV does not predict mortality. Overall, peripheral therapy with A6 and similar neutralizing mAbs promotes survival and long-term functional recovery from CNS-resident lyssavirus infection in a manner that includes suppression of the G pre- to postfusion transition and modulation of neuroinflammation.

papers.title: Knowledge, attitudes and practices among human rabies surveillance professionals: cross-sectional study, Nghe An province, Viet Nam, 2025
papers.abstract: Objective: To evaluate knowledge, attitudes and practices (KAP) of health professionals regarding rabies surveillance in Nghe An province, Viet Nam, and identify associated factors. Methods: A cross-sectional, descriptive and analytical study was conducted from 6 May to 30 June 2025. A structured questionnaire was distributed online to staff of preventive medicine, clinical and vaccination service units involved in rabies surveillance in Nghe An. For association analyses, KAP scores were categorized as adequate (>=70%) or inadequate (<70%). Descriptive statistics and logistic regression were performed. Results: Overall, 29.2% (69/236) of respondents had inadequate knowledge scores, 5.1% (12/236) had inadequate attitude scores and 35.2% (83/236) had inadequate practice scores. Among preventive medicine staff, major gaps included 80.6% (79/98) reporting that they did not share bite-victim data with veterinary services and 60.2% (59/98) reporting that they did not use data-analysis tools. Altogether, 77.3% (85/110) of district-level staff and 78.5% (51/65) of private-facility staff were rated as having adequate knowledge compared with 50% (28/56) of commune-level staff. Having received training in the past 12 months was strongly associated with adequate practices (OR: 5.09, 95% CI: 2.86–9.05). In the adjusted model, adequate practices were associated with training in the past 12 months (aOR: 3.27, 95% CI: 1.46–7.34), district/provincial-level work (aOR: 3.16, 95% CI: 1.26–7.90), working at a private facility (aOR: 7.86, 95% CI: 1.98– 31.24) and bachelor’s level or higher education (aOR: 2.29, 95% CI: 1.02–5.14). Discussion: Substantial gaps in surveillance-specific knowledge and practices were observed among surveillance professionals in Nghe An, particularly in preventive medicine and commune-level settings. Targeted training, routine use of data-analysis tools and stronger intersectoral data-sharing in line with existing national regulations are urgently needed to support Viet Nam’s goal of eliminating dog-mediated human rabies deaths by 2030.

papers.title_zh: 人类 狂犬病 监测 专业人员的知识、态度和实践:横断面研究,越南义安省,2025 年
papers.source_body_en: Objective: To evaluate knowledge, attitudes and practices (KAP) of health professionals regarding rabies surveillance in Nghe An province, Viet Nam, and identify associated factors. Methods: A cross-sectional, descriptive and analytical study was conducted from 6 May to 30 June 2025. A structured questionnaire was distributed online to staff of preventive medicine, clinical and vaccination service units involved in rabies surveillance in Nghe An. For association analyses, KAP scores were categorized as adequate (>=70%) or inadequate (<70%). Descriptive statistics and logistic regression were performed. Results: Overall, 29.2% (69/236) of respondents had inadequate knowledge scores, 5.1% (12/236) had inadequate attitude scores and 35.2% (83/236) had inadequate practice scores. Among preventive medicine staff, major gaps included 80.6% (79/98) reporting that they did not share bite-victim data with veterinary services and 60.2% (59/98) reporting that they did not use data-analysis tools. Altogether, 77.3% (85/110) of district-level staff and 78.5% (51/65) of private-facility staff were rated as having adequate knowledge compared with 50% (28/56) of commune-level staff. Having received training in the past 12 months was strongly associated with adequate practices (OR: 5.09, 95% CI: 2.86–9.05). In the adjusted model, adequate practices were associated with training in the past 12 months (aOR: 3.27, 95% CI: 1.46–7.34), district/provincial-level work (aOR: 3.16, 95% CI: 1.26–7.90), working at a private facility (aOR: 7.86, 95% CI: 1.98– 31.24) and bachelor’s level or higher education (aOR: 2.29, 95% CI: 1.02–5.14). Discussion: Substantial gaps in surveillance-specific knowledge and practices were observed among surveillance professionals in Nghe An, particularly in preventive medicine and commune-level settings. Targeted training, routine use of data-analysis tools and stronger intersectoral data-sharing in line with existing national regulations are urgently needed to support Viet Nam’s goal of eliminating dog-mediated human rabies deaths by 2030.

papers.title: SYN023, a Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Cocktail, Broadly Neutralizes Genetically Diverse Lyssaviruses and Validates Epitope Prediction Accuracy
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Lyssaviruses pose a persistent global public health threat, underscoring the need for broad-spectrum neutralizing antibodies to improve rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). The humanized monoclonal antibody cocktail SYN023 is approved for PEP in China and under active global regulatory review. This study aimed to validate pseudovirus-based neutralization assays, verify SYN023 epitope prediction accuracy, and systematically characterize its pan-lyssavirus neutralizing activity. Methods: Assay validation was performed by directly comparing neutralization titers obtained with authentic rabies virus (RABV) and pseudotyped virus. Epitope analysis was performed, followed by in vivo evaluation in a canine PEP challenge model. The pseudovirus-based neutralization assay was used to assess SYN023 broad-spectrum activity across diverse lyssaviruses. Results: Neutralization titers from authentic and pseudotyped viruses showed high concordance (R2 = 0.8341, p < 0.0001), supporting the pseudovirus system as a reliable surrogate assay. Epitope analysis confirmed that SYN023’s epitope is fully conserved in the highly virulent New York City (NYC) RABV strain. In canine PEP challenge studies using the NYC strain, SYN023 conferred strong protection at 0.1–0.5 mg/kg. SYN023 exhibited potent neutralizing activity against phylogenetically diverse non-rabies lyssaviruses, including Mokola virus (MOKV; EC50 = 14.74 μg/mL), whereas three clinically validated reference antibodies failed to neutralize MOKV even at concentrations up to 1000 μg/mL. Conclusions: This study demonstrates that the pseudovirus-based neutralization assay is a reliable surrogate assay. It also confirms the functional accuracy of the epitope mapping strategy and demonstrates the broad neutralization spectrum of SYN023 against a diverse panel of lyssaviruses.

source_records.abstract: Background/Objectives: Lyssaviruses pose a persistent global public health threat, underscoring the need for broad-spectrum neutralizing antibodies to improve rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). The humanized monoclonal antibody cocktail SYN023 is approved for PEP in China and under active global regulatory review. This study aimed to validate pseudovirus-based neutralization assays, verify SYN023 epitope prediction accuracy, and systematically characterize its pan-lyssavirus neutralizing activity. Methods: Assay validation was performed by directly comparing neutralization titers obtained with authentic rabies virus (RABV) and pseudotyped virus. Epitope analysis was performed, followed by in vivo evaluation in a canine PEP challenge model. The pseudovirus-based neutralization assay was used to assess SYN023 broad-spectrum activity across diverse lyssaviruses. Results: Neutralization titers from authentic and pseudotyped viruses showed high concordance (R2 = 0.8341, p < 0.0001), supporting the pseudovirus system as a reliable surrogate assay. Epitope analysis confirmed that SYN023’s epitope is fully conserved in the highly virulent New York City (NYC) RABV strain. In canine PEP challenge studies using the NYC strain, SYN023 conferred strong protection at 0.1–0.5 mg/kg. SYN023 exhibited potent neutralizing activity against phylogenetically diverse non-rabies lyssaviruses, including Mokola virus (MOKV; EC50 = 14.74 μg/mL), whereas three clinically validated reference antibodies failed to neutralize MOKV even at concentrations up to 1000 μg/mL. Conclusions: This study demonstrates that the pseudovirus-based neutralization assay is a reliable surrogate assay. It also confirms the functional accuracy of the epitope mapping strategy and demonstrates the broad neutralization spectrum of SYN023 against a diverse panel of lyssaviruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在验证基于假病毒的广谱中和抗体中和测定,并系统地表征 SYN023(一种人源化单克隆抗体混合物)的泛狂犬病病毒中和活​​性,以改善 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (PEP)。狂犬病病毒对全球公共卫生构成持续威胁,凸显了对广谱中和抗体的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在犬 PEP 攻击模型中评估了人源化单克隆抗体混合物 SYN023,并使用基于假病毒的中和测定来评估其针对多种狂犬病病毒的活性。
elements_zh.methods: 通过比较用真实的 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 和假型病毒获得的中和滴度进行测定验证。进行表位分析,并在犬 PEP 攻击模型中进行体内评估。基于假病毒的中和测定用于评估 SYN023 在不同狂犬病病毒中的广谱活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 真实病毒和假病毒的中和滴度表现出高度一致性(R2 = 0.8341,p < 0.0001)。表位分析证实了表位作图策略的功能准确性。SYN023 对系统发育多样化的非 狂犬病 狂犬病病毒表现出有效的中和活性,包括 Mokola 病毒(MOKV;EC50 = 14.74 μg/mL),而三种经过临床验证的参考抗体即使在浓度高达 1000 μg/mL 时也无法中和 MOKV。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,基于假病毒的中和测定是一种可靠的替代测定,并证实了表位作图策略的功能准确性。它还展示了 SYN023 对多种狂犬病病毒(包括 MOKV)的广泛中和谱。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改进的 狂犬病 PEP 的开发提供信息,并突显 SYN023 针对狂犬病毒的广谱保护的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性包括使用犬类模型和缺乏人类数据。由于使用了替代测定并且需要进一步的人体验证,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性包括使用犬类模型和缺乏人类数据。由于使用了替代测定并且需要进一步的人体验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Thực trạng kiến thức, thực hành về phòng chống bệnh dại và một số yếu tố liên quan ở người của người dân đến tiêm phòng tại trung tâm kiểm soát bệnh tật tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc năm 2024 Knowledge and practice on human rabies prevention and associated factors among individuals seeking post-exposure prophylaxis at vinh phuc center for disease control in 2024
papers.abstract: Nghiên cứu nhằm mục tiêu mô tả thực trạng kiến thức, thực hành về phòng chống bệnh dại ở người vàmột số yếu tố liên quan của người dân đến tiêm phòng tại Trung tâm Kiểm soát bệnh tật (CDC) tỉnh VĩnhPhúc năm 2024. Thiết kế nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang được thực hiện trên 169 người dân đến tiêm phòngdại do động vật cắn/cào từ tháng 3 đến tháng 11 năm 2024. Kết quả nghiên cứu cho thấy: Tỷ lệ đối tượngcó kiến thức đạt về phòng chống bệnh dại chiếm 56,2%; trong đó kiến thức về phòng bệnh bằng vắc xinđạt cao nhất (100%), nhưng kiến thức về xử trí vết thương đúng cách và phác đồ tiêm vắc xin còn hạn chế.Tỷ lệ đối tượng có thực hành đạt về phòng chống bệnh dại là 63,9%. Đối tượng nghiên cứu tới ngay cơ sởy tế sau khi xử trí vết thương ban đầu chiếm 92,3%. Phân tích mối liên quan cho thấy các yếu tố: trình độhọc vấn và hoàn cảnh kinh tế với thực hành phòng chống bệnh dại của đối tượng nghiên cứu (p < 0,05).Kiến thức và thực hành về phòng chống bệnh dại của người dân đến tiêm phòng tại Trung tâm Kiểm soátbệnh tật tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc còn chưa đồng đều, đặc biệt đối với các nội dung liên quan đến xử trí ban đầusau phơi nhiễm và nhận biết bệnh dại. Do đó, cần tăng cường truyền thông giáo dục sức khỏe, chú trọnghướng dẫn xử trí đúng sau phơi nhiễm và nâng cao nhận thức của người dân nhằm góp phần giảm nguycơ mắc và tử vong do bệnh dại.
papers.journal: Tạp chí Y học Dự phòng

papers.title_original: Rabies virus circulation in domestic mammals from a peri-urban area at the Pedra Branca Forest, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the circulation of rabies virus in domestic mammals within a peri-urban area adjacent to Pedra Branca Forest, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, to better understand the epidemiological dynamics of rabies in this region.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a peri-urban area near Pedra Branca Forest, Brazil, between 2021 and 2023, focusing on domestic mammals such as dogs and cats. A total of 120 samples were collected from these animals across multiple locations.
analysis.methods: Samples were collected from domestic mammals in the peri-urban area and tested using molecular assays to detect rabies virus RNA. The study involved collaboration with local rangers and utilized verified metadata for sample collection.
analysis.main_results: The study found that rabies virus was present in 15% of the collected samples, with a higher prevalence in dogs compared to cats. No significant differences were observed in the distribution of the virus across different locations.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the ongoing circulation of rabies virus in domestic mammals in the peri-urban area, emphasizing the need for targeted surveillance and control measures. This study provides novel insights into the spatial distribution of the virus in this specific ecological setting.

papers.title: A narrative review of rabies control strategies in wild carnivores across sub-Saharan Africa
papers.abstract: Rabies is a fatal zoonotic disease responsible for approximately 59,000 human deaths each year, significant livestock losses, and mortality in endangered wildlife populations. Jackals (Lupulella adusta and Lupulella mesomelas), bat-eared foxes (Otocyon megalotis) and mongooses (Cynictis penicillata and Herpestes sanguineus) have been identified as potential maintenance hosts in sub-Saharan Africa. This review aims to identify the most effective control (considering preventive measures, population control, and vaccination) and disease surveillance strategies to provide a guide for the implementation of rabies control plans across the region. A narrative review was conducted to find relevant peer-reviewed articles surrounding rabies control strategies within wild carnivores across the globe and specifically within sub-Saharan Africa. Overall, we conclude that a multifactorial control strategy is needed. The evidence suggests that a combination of preventive measures and point infection control with concurrent vaccination will be required to control initial rabies outbreaks, followed by mass oral vaccination of wild carnivores, parenteral vaccination (routes other than oral, such as intramuscular and subcutaneous injection) of endangered populations and optimisation of mass dog vaccination campaigns to enable long-term rabies control. These will need to be informed by data collected through strong surveillance networks. Our review yielded few existing studies and reports of control strategy implementation focused on sub-Saharan Africa. Therefore, controlling rabies within wild carnivores across sub-Saharan Africa will require considerable research, resources, effective and integrated surveillance systems, and interdisciplinary collaboration to develop and implement control strategies at a local and regional scale.

papers.title_zh: 对撒哈拉以南非洲野生食肉动物 狂犬病 控制策略的叙述性回顾
papers.source_body_en: Rabies is a fatal zoonotic disease responsible for approximately 59,000 human deaths each year, significant livestock losses, and mortality in endangered wildlife populations. Jackals (Lupulella adusta and Lupulella mesomelas), bat-eared foxes (Otocyon megalotis) and mongooses (Cynictis penicillata and Herpestes sanguineus) have been identified as potential maintenance hosts in sub-Saharan Africa. This review aims to identify the most effective control (considering preventive measures, population control, and vaccination) and disease surveillance strategies to provide a guide for the implementation of rabies control plans across the region. A narrative review was conducted to find relevant peer-reviewed articles surrounding rabies control strategies within wild carnivores across the globe and specifically within sub-Saharan Africa. Overall, we conclude that a multifactorial control strategy is needed. The evidence suggests that a combination of preventive measures and point infection control with concurrent vaccination will be required to control initial rabies outbreaks, followed by mass oral vaccination of wild carnivores, parenteral vaccination (routes other than oral, such as intramuscular and subcutaneous injection) of endangered populations and optimisation of mass dog vaccination campaigns to enable long-term rabies control. These will need to be informed by data collected through strong surveillance networks. Our review yielded few existing studies and reports of control strategy implementation focused on sub-Saharan Africa. Therefore, controlling rabies within wild carnivores across sub-Saharan Africa will require considerable research, resources, effective and integrated surveillance systems, and interdisciplinary collaboration to develop and implement control strategies at a local and regional scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 狂犬病 是一种致命的人畜共患疾病,每年导致约 59,000 人死亡、重大牲畜损失以及濒临灭绝的野生动物种群。豺狼(Lupulella adusta 和 Lupulella mesomelas)、蝙蝠耳狐(Otocyon megalotis)和猫鼬(Cynictis penicillata 和 Herpestes sanguineus)已被确定为撒哈拉以南非洲地区潜在的维持动物 宿主。本综述旨在确定最有效的控制(考虑预防措施、人口控制和疫苗接种)和疾病监测策略,为整个地区实施狂犬病控制计划提供指导。我们进行了叙述性审查,以查找有关全球野生食肉动物(特别是撒哈拉以南非洲地区)狂犬病 控制策略的相关同行评审文章。总的来说,我们的结论是需要多因素控制策略。证据表明,需要将预防措施和点感染控制与同时的 疫苗接种 相结合,以控制初始 狂犬病 疫苗接种,随后对野生食肉动物进行大规模口服 疫苗接种,对濒危人群进行肠胃外 疫苗接种(口服以外的途径,例如肌内和皮下注射),并优化大规模狗 疫苗接种 活动,以实现长期狂犬病控制。这些需要通过强大的 监测 网络收集的数据来了解。我们的审查很少有针对撒哈拉以南非洲地区的控制策略实施的现有研究和报告。因此,控制撒哈拉以南非洲野生食肉动物中的 狂犬病 将需要大量的研究、资源、有效和综合的 狂犬病 系统以及跨学科合作,以在当地和区域范围内制定和实施控制策略。

papers.title: Nationwide registry-based analysis of rabies exposures in Iran: Epidemiological patterns and post-exposure prophylaxis adherence
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Animal bites remain an important public health issue in Iran. Understanding their epidemiological patterns and examining how registry-recorded cases are managed in relation to the Iranian rabies protocol and World Health Organization recommendations can provide insight into clinical practice and documentation quality within the national bite registry. Such analyses help identify strengths and gaps in protocol adherence and data completeness. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: We conducted a secondary analysis of 507,404 animal bite cases recorded in the national rabies registry between March 2022 and September 2023. The unit of analysis was registry-recorded exposure visits. Data on demographics, exposure characteristics, and clinical management were examined to describe epidemiological patterns and assess documented adherence to recommended post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) practices. Males accounted for 73.6% of cases. The largest age group among all patients was 31-40 years, comprising 19.8% of cases. Dogs were responsible for 76.2% of exposures and cats for 20.8%. Northern provinces such as North Khorasan (773 per 100,000) and Golestan (767 per 100,000) recorded the highest incidence. Wound irrigation was documented in 94.3% of patients, and 96.4% received the first vaccine dose within 48 hours. Overall, 68.1% received three vaccine doses and 24.2% four doses. Rabies immunoglobulin was administered to 95.6% of Category III exposures, though inappropriate use was also observed in Category I (6.1%) and II (4.7%). Deviations from vaccine regimens and misclassification of exposure categories were identified, and among bat-related exposures only 36.8% were classified as Category III, with 38.7% receiving immunoglobulin. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Among registry-recorded animal bite attendees, rapid initiation of PEP and frequent appropriate use of rabies immunoglobulin in severe exposures were documented. However, gaps in documentation, vaccine dosing accuracy, and exposure classification indicate areas for improvement. These findings reflect patterns within the national bite registry and should not be interpreted as a comprehensive evaluation of all surveillance system attributes. Strengthening provider training, reinforcing protocol adherence, and improving data quality within the registry could support national rabies control efforts and inform broader prevention strategies aligned with global elimination goals.

Such analyses help identify strengths and gaps in protocol adherence and data completeness. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: We conducted a secondary analysis of 507,404 animal bite cases recorded in the national rabies registry between March 2022 and September 2023. The unit of analysis was registry-recorded exposure visits. Data on demographics, exposure characteristics, and clinical management were examined to describe epidemiological patterns and assess documented adherence to recommended post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) practices. Males accounted for 73.6% of cases. The largest age group among all patients was 31-40 years, comprising 19.8% of cases. Dogs were responsible for 76.2% of exposures and cats for 20.8%. Northern provinces such as North Khorasan (773 per 100,000) and Golestan (767 per 100,000) recorded the highest incidence. Wound irrigation was documented in 94.3% of patients, and 96.4% received the first vaccine dose within 48 hours. Overall, 68.1% received three vaccine doses and 24.2% four doses. Rabies immunoglobulin was administered to 95.6% of Category III exposures, though inappropriate use was also observed in Category I (6.1%) and II (4.7%). Deviations from vaccine regimens and misclassification of exposure categories were identified, and among bat-related exposures only 36.8% were classified as Category III, with 38.7% receiving immunoglobulin. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Among registry-recorded animal bite attendees, rapid initiation of PEP and frequent appropriate use of rabies immunoglobulin in severe exposures were documented. However, gaps in documentation, vaccine dosing accuracy, and exposure classification indicate areas for improvement. These findings reflect patterns within the national bite registry and should not be interpreted as a comprehensive evaluation of all surveillance system attributes. Strengthening provider training, reinforcing protocol adherence, and improving data quality within the registry could support national rabies control efforts and inform broader prevention strategies aligned with global elimination goals.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2022 年 3 月至 2023 年 9 月期间记录的 507,404 起动物咬伤案件进行了全国范围内的登记分析。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究涉及对登记处记录的暴露访问进行二次分析,检查人口统计、暴露特征和临床管理。
analysis_zh.main_results: 男性占病例的73.6%,最大年龄组为31-40岁(19.8%)。狗占 76.2%,猫占 20.8%。北方省份的 发病率 最高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果显示,在严重暴露情况下,可以快速启动 PEP 并经常适当使用 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白,但在文件记录、疫苗 剂量准确性和暴露分类方面发现了差距。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现反映了国家咬伤登记中的模式,可以为提供者培训、协议遵守和数据质量改进提供信息,以支持国家 狂犬病 控制工作。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到文件、疫苗 剂量准确性和暴露分类方面的空白的限制,表明了需要改进的领域。研究结果不应被解释为对所有 监测 系统属性的综合评估。

papers.title: Participatory Communication and Mass Dog Vaccination for Effective Rabies Management in Mitooma District, Western Uganda: An Exploratory Study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Canine rabies remains an endemic public health threat in Mitooma District, Uganda, where traditional, top–down public health interventions frequently fail to achieve the required 70% mass dog vaccination (MDV) coverage due to limited community engagement and one‐way communication. Objectives This exploratory study evaluated the effectiveness of participatory communication in enhancing community engagement in MDV programs at the human–dog–wildlife interface in Mitooma District and identified the sociocultural and ecological factors influencing rabies control. Methods Four gender‐segregated focus group discussions were conducted across four purposively selected parishes (Kiyanga, Kaburara, Iraramira, and Kashasha) in Kiyanga sub‐county, Mitooma District. Data were analyzed using thematic framework analysis. Results Critical gaps persist regarding paralytic rabies, non‐bite transmission pathways, and wildlife reservoirs, whereas inadequate interactive education drives the adoption of harmful traditional wound care. Furthermore, top–down vaccination mismatches and utilitarian canine views trigger booster noncompliance and ownership denial to evade medical and legal liabilities. Conclusion Rabies persistence in Mitooma District is fundamentally driven by a failure of bidirectional community engagement and multi‐sectoral coordination. Shifting from top–down public health messaging to a One Health participatory communication framework is necessary to establish sustainable community co‐ownership and break the transmission cycle.

It emphasizes the need for participatory communication strategies to enhance community involvement and address sociocultural and ecological factors influencing rabies persistence. papers.title_zh: 乌干达西部 Mitooma 区有效 狂犬病 管理的参与式沟通和大众狗 疫苗接种:一项探索性研究
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background Canine rabies remains an endemic public health threat in Mitooma District, Uganda, where traditional, top–down public health interventions frequently fail to achieve the required 70% mass dog vaccination (MDV) coverage due to limited community engagement and one‐way communication. Objectives This exploratory study evaluated the effectiveness of participatory communication in enhancing community engagement in MDV programs at the human–dog–wildlife interface in Mitooma District and identified the sociocultural and ecological factors influencing rabies control. Methods Four gender‐segregated focus group discussions were conducted across four purposively selected parishes (Kiyanga, Kaburara, Iraramira, and Kashasha) in Kiyanga sub‐county, Mitooma District. Data were analyzed using thematic framework analysis. Results Critical gaps persist regarding paralytic rabies, non‐bite transmission pathways, and wildlife reservoirs, whereas inadequate interactive education drives the adoption of harmful traditional wound care. Furthermore, top–down vaccination mismatches and utilitarian canine views trigger booster noncompliance and ownership denial to evade medical and legal liabilities. Conclusion Rabies persistence in Mitooma District is fundamentally driven by a failure of bidirectional community engagement and multi‐sectoral coordination. Shifting from top–down public health messaging to a One Health participatory communication framework is necessary to establish sustainable community co‐ownership and break the transmission cycle.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景 犬类 狂犬病 仍然是乌干达米图马区的一种地方性公共卫生威胁,由于社区参与和单向沟通有限,传统的自上而下的公共卫生干预措施经常无法实现所需的 70% 的犬类 狂犬病 (MDV) 覆盖率。目标 这项探索性研究评估了参与式沟通在增强 Mitooma 地区人-狗-野生动物交界处的 MDV 项目社区参与方面的有效性,并确定了影响 狂犬病 控制的社会文化和生态因素。方法 在米图马区基扬加县的四个有目的地选择的教区(基扬加、卡布拉拉、伊拉拉米拉和卡沙沙)进行了四次按性别隔离的焦点小组讨论。使用主题框架分析对数据进行分析。结果 在麻痹性 狂犬病、非咬合性 传播 通路和野生动物 储存宿主 方面仍然存在严重差距,而互动教育不足则导致采用有害的传统伤口护理。此外,自上而下的 疫苗接种 不匹配和功利主义的犬类观点会引发助推器不合规和否认所有权,以逃避医疗和法律责任。结论 Mitooma 地区 狂犬病 的持续存在从根本上来说是由于双向社区参与和多部门协调的失败造成的。从自上而下的公共卫生信息传递转向同一个健康参与式沟通框架对于建立可持续的社区共同所有权和打破 传播 循环是必要的。

papers.title: Situation Analysis of Rabies Surveillance and Dog Bite Management in Manufahi Municipality of Timor-Leste, 2025: A Mixed-Methods Quality Data Audit
papers.abstract: Objectives: Rabies has emerged as a significant public health threat in Timor-Leste, with 24 recorded human deaths since the disease first appeared in early 2024. While initially concentrated in border areas, the virus has spread to multiple municipalities, including Manufahi Municipality. This study presents a situational analysis of dog bite management concerning rabies risk, the timeliness of surveillance reports, and operational factors in Manufahi Municipality during 2025. Methods: A mixed-methods quality data audit was employed across four community health centers. Data collection encompassed direct observations of clinical areas, semi-structured interviews with 17 essential health personnel, and a methodical review and cross-verification of outpatient and laboratory register books. Results: The surveillance system achieved 100% timeliness in weekly reporting. In 2025, Manufahi Municipality recorded 295 dog bite cases, corresponding to an incidence of 4.63 per 1,000 population. Two patients (0.7%) died with clinical signs consistent with rabies. Children aged 5 to 14 years had the highest burden, accounting for 52.9% of cases. While vaccines arrived in June 2025, first-dose anti-rabies vaccine (ARV) coverage reached 84.4% overall (249/295) and 87.7% among eligible category II and III exposures (249/284). However, multi-dose adherence dropped to 28.9% (2 doses; 82/284) and 7.0% (3 doses; 20/284). Rabies immune globulin (RIG) coverage was 13.7% (31/226) among high-risk category III cases. Public Health Recommendations: Improving rabies control requires standardizing reporting formats and prioritizing the digitalization of surveillance systems. Adopting a "One Health" approach and enhancing community-level vaccine accessibility are vital for sustainable disease elimination.

papers.title: From Retina to Brain: Viral Tools for Targeting Retinal Cells and Mapping Visual Circuits.
papers.abstract: The retina serves as a uniquely accessible entry point to the central nervous system, enabling both cell type-specific manipulation and circuit-level interrogation of visual pathways. Viral vectors have emerged as indispensable tools in this context, facilitating precise gene delivery, functional perturbation, and connectivity mapping across retinal and brain circuits. Among retinal neurons, retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) represent a major focus due to their role as the sole output neurons conveying visual information to central targets. Accordingly, recent advances in viral engineering including capsid design, transcriptional targeting, and synthetic regulatory elements have significantly improved the efficiency and specificity of RGC-directed gene delivery, while also enabling targeting of diverse retinal cell populations. Beyond retinal targeting, viral tools have transformed the study of RGC connectivity with downstream brain nuclei. In particular, transsynaptic and projection-specific viral strategies now enable mapping of RGC inputs and outputs across visual pathways with increasing precision. Approaches using retrograde AAVs, monosynaptic rabies systems, and anterograde tracers have revealed complex, cell type-dependent wiring patterns linking the retina to thalamic, midbrain, and cortical circuits. In this review, we highlight current viral technologies for targeting RGCs and other retinal cell types and subsequently discuss viral approaches for dissecting retinal-brain connectivity. Together, these complementary strategies provide a powerful framework for linking molecular identity, circuit architecture, and visual function, thereby advancing both basic neuroscience and translational efforts in vision research.

The target-specific evidence is limited to monosynaptic rabies systems, which are mentioned among retrograde AAVs and anterograde tracers used to reveal complex, cell type-dependent wiring patterns linking the retina to thalamic, midbrain, and cortical circuits. papers.title_zh: 从视网膜到大脑:针对视网膜细胞和绘制视觉回路的病毒工具。

papers.abstract_zh: 视网膜是中枢神经系统的独特入口点,可实现细胞类型特异性操作和视觉通路的电路级询问。病毒 媒介 已成为这种背景下不可或缺的工具,促进精确的基因传递、功能扰动以及视网膜和大脑回路的连接映射。在视网膜神经元中,视网膜神经节细胞(RGC)因其作为向中央目标传递视觉信息的唯一输出神经元的作用而成为主要焦点。因此,病毒工程的最新进展,包括衣壳设计、转录靶向和合成调控元件,显着提高了 RGC 引导的基因递送的效率和特异性,同时还能够靶向不同的视网膜细胞群。除了视网膜靶向之外,病毒工具还改变了 RGC 与下游脑核连接的研究。特别是,跨突触和投射特异性病毒策略现在能够以越来越高的精度映射视觉通路上的 RGC 输入和输出。使用逆行 AAV、单突触 狂犬病 系统和顺行示踪剂的方法揭示了连接视网膜与丘脑、中脑和皮质回路的复杂的、依赖于细胞类型的接线模式。在这篇综述中,我们重点介绍了当前针对 RGC 和其他视网膜细胞类型的病毒技术,并随后讨论了解剖视网膜-大脑连接的病毒方法。这些互补策略共同提供了一个强大的框架,用于连接分子身份、电路结构和视觉功能,从而推进基础神经科学和视觉研究的转化工作。

papers.title: Combined Disruption of Multiple Cytokine Signaling Pathways Enables One-Step Anterograde Tracing with Vesicular Stomatitis Virus.
papers.abstract: Defining the direct postsynaptic targets of selected neuronal populations remains a challenge for neural circuit mapping. Vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) spreads efficiently in the anterograde direction, but replication-competent VSV undergoes multistep spread and therefore cannot distinguish direct from indirect downstream targets. Here, we developed a glycoprotein-deleted VSV (VSVdG)-based strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using AAV-mediated trans-complementation with adaptations. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 定义选定神经元群的直接突触后目标仍然是神经回路映射的一个挑战。本研究旨在开发一种使用改良的水泡性口炎病毒(VSV)系统进行一步顺行追踪的策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及开发一种基于糖蛋白删除的 VSV (VSVdG) 策略,用于使用 AAV 介导的反式互补进行一步顺行追踪。这项研究是在雌雄小鼠中进行的,以基底神经节回路作为模型系统。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法包括对 VSVdG 进行工程改造以编码 Cre,从而允许依赖 Cre 的 AAV 仅在 VSVdG 感染相同细胞后才表达 VSV-G。为了减少 VSV-M 介导的细胞毒性,引入了 M33A/M51R 双突变 VSV-Md 变体。该系统在细胞因子介导的 抗病毒药物 反应中断的小鼠中进行了测试。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究以基底神经节回路为模型,发现有效的一步式 VSVdG 传播需要破坏由 AAV 转导和 VSV 感染触发的细胞因子介导的 抗病毒药物 反应。这些适应使 VSVdG 从两性小鼠的背侧纹状体传播到预期的下游目标。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明 VSVdG 策略可以实现一步顺行追踪,但他们也强调下游标记细胞包括神经元和神经胶质细胞,揭示了将这种方法解释为严格的神经元到神经元单突触顺行传播的一个重要限制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更有效、更特异的单突触顺行病毒示踪剂来绘制神经回路图提供信息,这对理解大脑连接和功能具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究表明,下游标记细胞包括神经元和神经胶质细胞,这表明将该方法解释为严格的神经元到神经元单突触顺行传播存在局限性。证据是中等的,因为该研究侧重于特定的模型系统,并没有推广到更广泛的背景。

papers.title: Increasing dog bites in humans: Indoor and outdoor risk factors and spatiotemporal patterns in Chile.
papers.abstract: Dog bites pose a serious global public health problem, leading to at least 14,000 annual deaths globally, primarily from rabies, and contributing to physical injuries, psychological trauma, transmission to other zoonotic diseases, and substantial economic costs. This study aimed to estimate the spatiotemporal distribution of dog bite incidents involving humans in Chile and to analyze the risk factors associated with bites in indoor and outdoor environments. We analyzed data from the Registry System of Biting Animals (SIRAM) in Chile between 2019 and 2024. To examine spatiotemporal patterns of dog bites and associated risk factors, we conducted time-series analyses, spatial autocorrelation, and generalized linear mixed-effects models with a negative binomial distribution. The cumulative rate of reported dog bites was 263 (95% CI: 262.5-264.3) per 100,000 inhabitants and increased from 216 (95% CI: 214-218) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 400 (95% CI: 398-403) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2024. Cases were widely distributed across all regions, with clusters of municipalities showing high rates. The risk of reported dog bites was twice as high in outdoor compared to indoor settings (adjusted incidence rate ratio [aIRR]=2.01; 95% CI 1.98-2.03), and disproportionately affected males (aIRR=1.47; 95% CI 1.45-1.49) and individuals aged 10-69 years, whereas indoor bites presented more uniform risk patterns across demographic groups. Time series revealed an increasing trend since 2022 and a seasonal pattern. Regression models showed the highest reported bite rate occurred during the spring months in both indoor (aIRR=1.14; 95% CI 1.12-1.17) and outdoor (aIRR=1.2; 95% CI 1.18-1.22) settings. Dog bite incidents are a growing public health concern in Chile, influenced by human, animal, and environmental factors. This increase may reflect both a true rise in dog bite occurrence and improvements in surveillance sensitivity. Addressing this multifactorial problem requires a comprehensive One Health approach, including reducing the number of unsupervised dogs outdoors, raising public awareness, and establishing a comprehensive registry of severe and non-severe cases to assess the burden of dog bites. These measures are critical for the effective prevention and control of dog bite incidents.

elements_zh.methods: 为了检查狗咬伤的时空模式和相关风险因素,我们进行了时间序列分析、空间自相关和具有负二项分布的广义线性混合效应模型。回归模型显示,在室内(aIRR=1.14;95% CI 1.12-1.17)和室外(aIRR=1.2;95% CI 1.18-1.22)环境中,报告的咬伤率最高发生在春季。
elements_zh.main_results: The cumulative rate of reported dog bites was 263 (95% CI: 262.5-264.3) per 100,000 inhabitants and increased from 216 (95% CI: 214-218) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 400 (95% CI: 398-403) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2024. The risk of reported dog bites was twice as high in outdoor compared to indoor settings (adjusted incidence rate ratio [aIRR]=2.01; 95% CI 1.98-2.03), and disproportionately affected males (aIRR=1.47; 95% CI 1.45-1.49) and individuals aged 10-69 years, whereas indoor bites presented more uniform risk patterns across demographic groups. Time series revealed an increasing trend since 2022 and a seasonal pattern.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 受人类、动物和环境因素的影响,狗咬伤事件已成为智利日益严重的公共卫生问题。这些措施对于有效预防和控制狗咬伤事件至关重要。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 解决这一多因素问题需要采取全面的“同一个健康”方法,包括减少户外无人看管的狗的数量、提高公众意识以及建立严重和非严重病例的综合登记册以评估狗咬伤的负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有报告任何具体的设计限制或偏见。然而,报告的狗咬伤事件的增加趋势可能反映了狗咬伤发生率的真正上升和 监测 敏感性的改善。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to estimate the spatiotemporal distribution of dog bite incidents involving humans in Chile and to analyze the risk factors associated with bites in indoor and outdoor environments. Dog bites pose a serious global public health problem, leading to at least 14,000 annual deaths globally, primarily from rabies, and contributing to physical injuries, psychological trauma, transmission to other zoonotic diseases, and substantial economic costs.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed data from the Registry System of Biting Animals (SIRAM) in Chile between 2019 and 2024. Cases were widely distributed across all regions, with clusters of municipalities showing high rates.
analysis_en.methods: To examine spatiotemporal patterns of dog bites and associated risk factors, we conducted time-series analyses, spatial autocorrelation, and generalized linear mixed-effects models with a negative binomial distribution. Regression models showed the highest reported bite rate occurred during the spring months in both indoor (aIRR=1.14; 95% CI 1.12-1.17) and outdoor (aIRR=1.2; 95% CI 1.18-1.22) settings.
analysis_en.main_results: The cumulative rate of reported dog bites was 263 (95% CI: 262.5-264.3) per 100,000 inhabitants and increased from 216 (95% CI: 214-218) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 400 (95% CI: 398-403) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2024. The risk of reported dog bites was twice as high in outdoor compared to indoor settings (adjusted incidence rate ratio [aIRR]=2.01; 95% CI 1.98-2.03), and disproportionately affected males (aIRR=1.47; 95% CI 1.45-1.49) and individuals aged 10-69 years, whereas indoor bites presented more uniform risk patterns across demographic groups. Time series revealed an increasing trend since 2022 and a seasonal pattern.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Dog bite incidents are a growing public health concern in Chile, influenced by human, animal, and environmental factors. These measures are critical for the effective prevention and control of dog bite incidents.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Addressing this multifactorial problem requires a comprehensive One Health approach, including reducing the number of unsupervised dogs outdoors, raising public awareness, and establishing a comprehensive registry of severe and non-severe cases to assess the burden of dog bites.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study does not report any specific design limitations or bias. However, the increasing trend in reported dog bites may reflect both a true rise in dog bite occurrence and improvements in surveillance sensitivity.

papers.title_zh: 人类被狗咬伤的增加:智利的室内和室外风险因素和时空模式。
papers.source_body_en: Dog bites pose a serious global public health problem, leading to at least 14,000 annual deaths globally, primarily from rabies, and contributing to physical injuries, psychological trauma, transmission to other zoonotic diseases, and substantial economic costs. This study aimed to estimate the spatiotemporal distribution of dog bite incidents involving humans in Chile and to analyze the risk factors associated with bites in indoor and outdoor environments. We analyzed data from the Registry System of Biting Animals (SIRAM) in Chile between 2019 and 2024. To examine spatiotemporal patterns of dog bites and associated risk factors, we conducted time-series analyses, spatial autocorrelation, and generalized linear mixed-effects models with a negative binomial distribution. The cumulative rate of reported dog bites was 263 (95% CI: 262.5-264.3) per 100,000 inhabitants and increased from 216 (95% CI: 214-218) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 400 (95% CI: 398-403) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2024. Cases were widely distributed across all regions, with clusters of municipalities showing high rates. The risk of reported dog bites was twice as high in outdoor compared to indoor settings (adjusted incidence rate ratio [aIRR]=2.01; 95% CI 1.98-2.03), and disproportionately affected males (aIRR=1.47; 95% CI 1.45-1.49) and individuals aged 10-69 years, whereas indoor bites presented more uniform risk patterns across demographic groups. Time series revealed an increasing trend since 2022 and a seasonal pattern. Regression models showed the highest reported bite rate occurred during the spring months in both indoor (aIRR=1.14; 95% CI 1.12-1.17) and outdoor (aIRR=1.2; 95% CI 1.18-1.22) settings. Dog bite incidents are a growing public health concern in Chile, influenced by human, animal, and environmental factors. This increase may reflect both a true rise in dog bite occurrence and improvements in surveillance sensitivity. Addressing this multifactorial problem requires a comprehensive One Health approach, including reducing the number of unsupervised dogs outdoors, raising public awareness, and establishing a comprehensive registry of severe and non-severe cases to assess the burden of dog bites. These measures are critical for the effective prevention and control of dog bite incidents.

papers.title: A G4-nanotweezer/DNA tetrahedron-confined dual-mode ECL/SERS biosensor for ultrasensitive rabies viral RNA detection via CRISPR-Cas12a-regulated hemin switching.
papers.abstract: Reliable detection of low-abundance rabies viral RNA (RABV RNA) requires sensitive readouts that tolerate interfacial and matrix-associated signal variation. We developed a DNA tetrahedron-confined G4-nanotweezer biosensor combining electrochemiluminescence (ECL) and surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS). A Ti 3 C 2 /CsPbBr 3 @PDA@AuNPs nanocomposite (PAM) provided the dual-mode transducing interface, with hemin serving as both an ECL-modulating species and a SERS reporter. CsPbBr 3 served as the ECL emitter, PDA improved interfacial stability, AuNPs provided SERS hotspots and DNA anchoring sites, and Ti 3 C 2 acted as a conductive scaffold. Without target RNA, the bridging strand (ST) promoted a closed G4/hemin configuration, producing high SERS and low ECL signals. RABV RNA-triggered binding-induced isothermal amplification generated single-stranded DNA activators for CRISPR-Cas12a. Subsequent ST cleavage prevented nanotweezer closure and reduced interfacial hemin enrichment, producing an ECL-on/SERS-off response. Control experiments linked hemin-associated ECL modulation to the interfacial configuration without establishing a unique microscopic quenching pathway. The ratiometric signal R = I ECL /I SERS enabled quantification over 1 aM to 50 fM. Additional low-concentration calibration yielded an estimated detection limit of 0.0675 aM by blank-threshold inverse prediction, extrapolated below the lowest measured nonzero standard of 0.10 aM. At 10 fM, matched-channel comparisons gave ratiometric relative standard deviations of 2.49% for ten successive readings and 2.87% across six independently prepared electrodes. In tenfold-diluted human serum at 10 fM, the ratio showed an 8.20% absolute deviation from phosphate-buffered saline, indicating partial matrix-effect compensation. This shared-reporter architecture links programmable DNA switching to complementary optical readouts for sensitive ratiometric viral RNA analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a novel biosensor for ultrasensitive rabies viral RNA detection. The biosensor combines G4-nanotweezer and DNA tetrahedron technologies with electrochemiluminescence (ECL) and surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) for dual-mode readouts. The biosensor uses a Ti3C2/CsPbBr3@PDA@AuNPs nanocomposite (PAM) as a transducing interface, where hemin functions as both an ECL-modulating species and a SERS reporter. The biosensor's design allows for programmable DNA switching via CRISPR-Cas12a, enabling ratiometric quantification of RABV RNA over a wide range of concentrations (1 aM to 50 fM). The study highlights the potential of this biosensor for sensitive and accurate rabies viral RNA analysis, which could improve surveillance and diagnostic capabilities. However, the study notes that control experiments only link hemin-associated ECL modulation to interfacial configuration without confirming a unique quenching pathway, which may limit the interpretation of the findings. The biosensor's performance was tested in phosphate-buffered saline and human serum, showing partial matrix-effect compensation. The results suggest that this biosensor could be a valuable tool for detecting rabies virus in clinical and field settings, but further validation is needed to confirm its reliability and specificity.

papers.title_zh: G4 纳米镊子/DNA 四面体限制双模式 ECL/SERS 生物传感器,通过 CRISPR-Cas12a 调节的氯化血红素开关实现超灵敏 狂犬病 病毒 RNA 检测。
papers.source_body_en: Reliable detection of low-abundance rabies viral RNA (RABV RNA) requires sensitive readouts that tolerate interfacial and matrix-associated signal variation. We developed a DNA tetrahedron-confined G4-nanotweezer biosensor combining electrochemiluminescence (ECL) and surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS). A Ti 3 C 2 /CsPbBr 3 @PDA@AuNPs nanocomposite (PAM) provided the dual-mode transducing interface, with hemin serving as both an ECL-modulating species and a SERS reporter. CsPbBr 3 served as the ECL emitter, PDA improved interfacial stability, AuNPs provided SERS hotspots and DNA anchoring sites, and Ti 3 C 2 acted as a conductive scaffold. Without target RNA, the bridging strand (ST) promoted a closed G4/hemin configuration, producing high SERS and low ECL signals. RABV RNA-triggered binding-induced isothermal amplification generated single-stranded DNA activators for CRISPR-Cas12a. Subsequent ST cleavage prevented nanotweezer closure and reduced interfacial hemin enrichment, producing an ECL-on/SERS-off response. Control experiments linked hemin-associated ECL modulation to the interfacial configuration without establishing a unique microscopic quenching pathway. The ratiometric signal R = I ECL /I SERS enabled quantification over 1 aM to 50 fM. Additional low-concentration calibration yielded an estimated detection limit of 0.0675 aM by blank-threshold inverse prediction, extrapolated below the lowest measured nonzero standard of 0.10 aM. At 10 fM, matched-channel comparisons gave ratiometric relative standard deviations of 2.49% for ten successive readings and 2.87% across six independently prepared electrodes. In tenfold-diluted human serum at 10 fM, the ratio showed an 8.20% absolute deviation from phosphate-buffered saline, indicating partial matrix-effect compensation. This shared-reporter architecture links programmable DNA switching to complementary optical readouts for sensitive ratiometric viral RNA analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 低丰度 狂犬病 病毒 RNA (RABV RNA) 的可靠检测需要灵敏的读数,能够耐受界面和基质相关的信号变化。我们开发了一种结合电化学发光 (ECL) 和表面增强拉曼散射 (SERS) 的 DNA 四面体限制 G4 纳米镊子生物传感器。Ti 3 C 2 /CsPbBr 3 @PDA@AuNPs 纳米复合材料 (PAM) 提供双模式转导界面,氯高铁血红素既充当 ECL 调节物质,又充当 SERS 报道分子。CsPbBr 3 充当ECL发射器,PDA改善界面稳定性,AuNP提供SERS热点和DNA锚定位点,Ti 3 C 2 充当导电支架。如果没有目标 RNA,桥接链 (ST) 会促进闭合的 G4/氯化血红素构型,产生高 SERS 和低 ECL 信号。RABV RNA 触发的结合诱导的等温扩增产生了 CRISPR-Cas12a 的单链 DNA 激活剂。随后的 ST 裂解阻止了纳米镊子的闭合并减少了界面血红素的富集,从而产生了 ECL-on/SERS-off 响应。对照实验将氯化血红素相关的 ECL 调节与界面结构联系起来,但没有建立独特的微观猝灭途径。比率信号 R = I ECL /I SERS 可实现 1 aM 至 50 fM 范围内的定量。额外的低浓度校准通过空白阈值逆预测产生了 0.0675 aM 的估计检测限,推断低于 0.10 aM 的最低测量非零标准。在 10 fM 时,匹配通道比较得出十个连续读数的比率相对标准偏差为 2.49%,六个独立制备的电极的比率相对标准偏差为 2.87%。在 10 fM 十倍稀释的人血清中,该比率显示与磷酸盐缓冲盐水有 8.20% 的绝对偏差,表明部分基质效应补偿。这种共享报告架构将可编程 DNA 切换与互补光学读数连接起来,以进行灵敏的比率病毒 RNA 分析。

papers.title: Digital reminder systems for improving adherence to anti-rabies vaccination among animal bite victims: A systematic review
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Digital reminder systems may improve adherence to scheduled vaccination visits. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of digital reminder interventions in improving adherence to and completion of anti-rabies vaccination among animal bite patients. Methods A systematic search of PubMed, EMBASE, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library was conducted on September 28, 2025 following a registered PROSPERO protocol (CRD420251148817). Two reviewers independently screened studies using NESTED Knowledge, extracted data, and assessed study quality using the Cochrane RoB-2 tool and the JBI critical appraisal checklist. Results Of 733 records identified, 436 remained after duplicate record removal and were screened by the title and abstract. Twelve studies underwent full-text assessment, and three that met the inclusion criteria were conducted in Tanzania, Kenya, and India. Two quasi-experimental studies evaluated SMS reminder systems, and one randomised controlled trial evaluated telephonic reminders. All studies reported improved adherence to scheduled anti-rabies vaccination compared with routine care. Vaccination completion was 70% vs 53% in the telephonic reminder trial and 93% vs 78% in the SMS reminder study. In the Tanzanian study adherence improved across four doses (62%, 50%, 29%, 13%) with SMS reminders compared with controls (48%, 41%, 22%, 7%). Differences in study design, vaccination regimens, and intervention modalities limited direct comparison across studies. Interpretation and conclusions Digital reminder interventions may improve adherence to anti-rabies vaccination schedules, but available evidence is limited and heterogeneous, resulting in low certainty of evidence. Larger randomised trials are required to determine the effectiveness and scalability of digital reminder systems.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目标 数字提醒系统可以提高对预定 疫苗接种 就诊的遵守率。本系统评价旨在评估数字提醒干预措施在提高动物咬伤患者遵守和完成抗 狂犬病 疫苗接种 治疗方面的有效性。方法 按照注册的 PROSPERO 方案 (CRD420251148817),于 2025 年 9 月 28 日对 PubMed、EMBASE、Web of Science 和 Cochrane 图书馆进行了系统检索。两名评审员使用 NESTED Knowledge 独立筛选研究,提取数据,并使用 Cochrane RoB-2 工具和 JBI 批判性评估清单评估研究质量。结果 在识别出的 733 条记录中,删除重复记录后保留 436 条,并通过标题和摘要进行筛选。十二项研究进行了全文评估,其中三项符合纳入标准,是在坦桑尼亚、肯尼亚和印度进行的。两项准实验研究评估了短信提醒系统,一项随机对照试验评估了电话提醒。所有研究均报告与常规护理相比,对预定抗 狂犬病 疫苗接种 的依从性有所提高。在电话提醒试验中,疫苗接种 的完成率为 70% 对 53%,在短信提醒研究中完成率为 93% 对 78%。在坦桑尼亚的研究中,与对照组(48%、41%、22%、7%)相比,使用短信提醒的四种剂量(62%、50%、29%、13%)的依从性有所提高。研究设计、疫苗接种 方案和干预方式的差异限制了研究之间的直接比较。解释和结论数字提醒干预措施可能会提高对反 狂犬病 疫苗接种 时间表的依从性,但可用证据有限且异构,导致证据质量低。需要更大规模的随机试验来确定数字提醒系统的有效性和可扩展性。

papers.title: Rabies risk and response in tea-estate health systems in Assam, India: a constructivist grounded theory analysis.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Dog-mediated rabies disproportionately affects marginalised and geographically isolated communities, including tea-estate (TE) populations in Assam, India. Although epidemiological patterns of rabies transmission are well documented, the structural, behavioural and governance mechanisms shaping prevention and response within estate-based health systems remain poorly understood. This study used a constructivist grounded theory approach to examine how TE health systems perceive and respond to rabies risk. METHODS: We conducted 26 interview events comprising 25 in-depth individual interviews and one group interview, involving 28 participants from estate healthcare, welfare, management and labour representative roles across 10 TE in Udalguri district, Assam. Purposive maximum-variation sampling ensured representation across roles, responsibilities and decision-making influence. Initial line-by-line coding, constant comparison, focused category development and memo writing informed the development of an emergent explanatory model, which subsequently informed an applied theory of change. Rigour was ensured through reflexive team discussions, consensus-based resolution of coding discrepancies and adherence to Consolidated Criteria for Reporting Qualitative Research (COREQ) criteria. RESULTS: Responses to rabies risk were shaped by five interacting mechanisms: structural inequities in access to postexposure prophylaxis; incident-driven vigilance; fragmented governance and the absence of institutionalised dog-population management; limited health literacy resulting from ineffective communication approaches and weak surveillance systems. Collectively, these processes produced a system that remains predominantly reactive rather than preventive, perpetuating cycles of delayed care, incomplete prophylaxis and unmanaged dog-human interfaces. The emergent theory of change highlights feasible opportunities for shifting estate-based systems towards proactive rabies prevention. CONCLUSION: This study offers an analytically transferable health-systems model that may inform structurally peripheral or semi-autonomous labour communities across comparable plantation, industrial and labour settlements in South and Southeast Asia, identifying implementation pathways aligned with India's National Action Plan for Rabies Elimination 2030 and the global 'Zero by 30' agenda.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解印度阿萨姆邦的茶园卫生系统如何看待和应对 狂犬病 风险,因为狗介导的 狂犬病 对边缘化和地理位置偏僻的社区造成了不成比例的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在阿萨姆邦 Udalguri 地区的 10 个茶园进行,涉及 28 名来自医疗保健、福利、管理和劳工代表角色的参与者,进行了 26 次访谈活动。
elements_zh.methods: 使用了建构主义扎根理论方法,并有目的的最大变异抽样,以确保跨角色、职责和决策影响的代表性。通过反思性的团队讨论、基于共识的编码差异解决方案以及遵守定性研究报告综合标准 (COREQ),确保了严谨性。
elements_zh.main_results: 对 狂犬病 风险的反应由五种相互作用的机制决定:获得暴露后预防的结构性不平等;事件驱动的警惕;治理分散,缺乏制度化的犬只管理;由于沟通方法无效和 监测 系统薄弱,健康素养有限。总的来说,这些过程产生了一个主要是反应性而非预防性的系统,延迟护理、不完全预防和不受管理的狗与人界面的持续循环。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果揭示了一个反应性而非预防性的系统,强调需要进行结构性变革,以改善茶园卫生系统的 狂犬病 预防和响应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入了解了半自治劳动社区中 狂犬病 预防和应对的结构和治理机制,这可能为未来根据印度《2030 年消除 狂犬病 国家行动计划》和全球“30 年前零排放”议程采取的干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于定性访谈,不提供定量数据,这限制了研究结果的普遍性。由于研究的探索性,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:狗介导的 狂犬病 对边缘化和地理上孤立的社区造成了不成比例的影响,包括印度阿萨姆邦的茶园 (TE) 人口。尽管 狂犬病 传播 的流行病学模式已有详细记录,但对基于庄园的卫生系统内形成预防和应对的结构、行为和治理机制仍知之甚少。本研究使用建构主义扎根理论方法来研究 TE 卫生系统如何感知和应对 狂犬病 风险。方法:我们进行了 26 场访谈活动,其中包括 25 场深度个人访谈和 1 场集体访谈,涉及阿萨姆邦 Udalguri 地区 10 个 TE 的房地产医疗保健、福利、管理和劳工代表职位的 28 名参与者。有目的的最大变异抽样确保了角色、职责和决策影响力的代表性。最初的逐行编码、不断比较、重点类别开发和备忘录编写为新兴解释模型的发展提供了信息,该模型随后为应用变革理论提供了信息。通过反思性的团队讨论、基于共识的编码差异解决方案以及遵守定性研究报告综合标准 (COREQ),确保了严谨性。结果:对 狂犬病 风险的反应由五种相互作用的机制决定:获得暴露后预防的结构性不平等;事件驱动的警惕;治理分散,缺乏制度化的犬只管理;由于沟通方法无效和 监测 系统薄弱,健康素养有限。总的来说,这些过程产生了一个主要是反应性而非预防性的系统,延迟护理、不完全预防和不受管理的狗与人界面的持续循环。新兴的变革理论强调了将基于财产的系统转向主动 狂犬病 预防的可行机会。结论:本研究提供了一种分析上可转移的卫生系统模型,可以为南亚和东南亚类似种植园、工业和劳工住区的结构性外围或半自治劳工社区提供信息,确定与印度《2030 年消除 狂犬病 国家行动计划》和全球“零到 30”议程相一致的实施路径。
